rows.claim: defendant A (claim): the two TCP-acquisition states are twins -- Connect is 'waiting for the TCP connection to be completed' (snapshot txt:3012-3013) and Active is 'trying to acquire a peer by listening for, and accepting, a TCP connection' (txt:3257-3258) -- and they run the same machinery: both drop to Idle on ManualStop (txt:3017-3036 / txt:3262-3278), both enter OpenSent on DelayOpenTimer expiry and on TCP success (txt:3054-3061 + txt:3089-3100 / txt:3292-3313 + txt:3340-3350), both reach OpenConfirm on a delayed OPEN (Event 20; txt:3127-3161 / txt:3378-3404), both sink to Idle on TcpConnectionFails (txt:3117-3125 / txt:3355-3376) -- so swapping states 1 <-> 2 should map the connection-establishment half of the FSM onto itself.

defendant B: OpenConfirm and Established are the two session-live states -- both answer ManualStop, AutomaticStop and HoldTimer expiry with a NOTIFICATION and a drop to Idle (txt:3715-3746, txt:3748-3773 / txt:3940-3974, txt:3988-4005), both keep the session alive on their periodic machinery (OpenConfirm 'remains in the OpenConfirmed state' on Event 11, txt:3775-3782; Established 'remains in the Established state' on Events 26/27, txt:4095-4111), and both sink to Idle on NOTIFICATION or TCP failure (txt:3792-3826 / txt:4064-4078) -- so maybe states 4 <-> 5 can be swapped alone

defendant C: OpenSent and OpenConfirm are the two mid-negotiation states -- OpenSent 'waits for an OPEN message from its peer' (txt:3497) and OpenConfirm 'waits for a KEEPALIVE or NOTIFICATION message' (txt:3710); both drain to Idle on the administrative and hold-time events in the same prose pattern ('changes its state to Idle' per paragraph, txt:3502-3558 / txt:3715-3773) -- so maybe states 3 <-> 4 can be swapped alone
positive control: padding states 6 and 7 have byte-identical rows (every event self-loops, reward 0), so the swap is a genuine symmetry under BOTH readings and should be admitted everywhere
